### What Makes God Cry
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-march-19-2024.html
Passage: Luke 19:41
Points:
- While the crowds cheered on Palm Sunday, Jesus wept because He knew their shallow praise would soon turn into calls for His crucifixion.
- In His omniscience, Jesus foresaw the tragic destruction of Jerusalem in AD 70 resulting from the people missing their day of visitation.
- God does not force anyone to receive Him, but human unbelief and rejection deeply grieve His heart.
- Sin carries devastating, destructive repercussions for human lives both in this world and in eternity.

### Jesus Wept Over the City [Passion Week Devotions]
Author: Erik Raymond
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/erik-raymond/passion-week-devotions-jesus-wept-over-the-city/
Passage: Luke 19:41
Points:
- Rather than rushing to consider historical judgment, believers should pause to see the deep grief displayed in Christ's tears.
- Jesus was not emotionally detached; His heart broke over lost people facing judgment and disaster.
- Approaching His execution, Christ wept over the fickleness, feigned worship, and hardness of heart among those who would kill Him.
- Jesus openly displayed holy sorrow without fear of human opinion, convicting Christians to examine their own compassion for their cities.
